project_type: Vite + React + TypeScript + Three.js game with Tailwind CSS
test_framework: No test framework detected - verification via build only
test_command: npm run build (no test suite, build is the verification)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build from the game folder to ensure TypeScript compiles without errors and the bundle is produced successfully
environment_constraints: Must work within the game folder only. Three.js imports must be removed from MainMenu.tsx since the menu becomes pure CSS/HTML.
contribution_requirements: Keep the same MainMenuProps interface: { onOpenEditor: () => void }. Keep QualitySettings import for settings panel. Remove all Three.js usage from the menu component.
key_patterns: Components use React functional components with hooks. Tailwind CSS for styling with inline styles for animations. Existing Windows-style components (Minesweeper.tsx, Paint.tsx) already exist in the project with win7-inspired UI patterns. The app routes between 'menu' and 'editor' modes via App.tsx.
directory_structure: src/components/ - UI components (MainMenu, EditorUI, GuardMenu, Minesweeper, Paint); src/game/ - game systems (QualitySettings, Combat, etc.); src/editor/ - map editor code
